query: query baton_pullRequests($userId: ID!) { atlassianUserPullRequests(userId: $userId, roles: [CREATED, REVIEWED], since: "P90D", first: 25) { edges { node { __typename ... on ExternalPullRequest { id displayId title url status createdAt lastUpdatedAt repositoryId commentCount author { id name } reviewers { approvalStatus user { id name } } } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
